info.description: Implemented local demo, HTTPS user authentication and separate password/TOTP admin authentication. Read-only management views. No production bind or real VPN delivery.

Local HTTPS user-only recovery. Issuance is trusted CLI only and immediately disables old password and revokes sessions. This endpoint consumes a single-use recovery token, saves a new password, revokes remaining tokens/sessions, clears cookies and does not auto-login. Preauth CSRF, exact Origin, JSON <=64 KiB. No changes to VPN profiles.

204.description: Password changed; no session created. Cookies cleared; bootstrap and ordinary login required.

ProfileDiagnostics.description: Read-only portal metadata projection. Configuration comparison alone never attests a live connection, client compatibility, actual peer installation, readiness or permission to download. Stored AWG observation expires after 60 seconds. No network/core calls or control/key access.

checkedAt.description: Canonical UTC timestamp of the stored comparison; only emitted together with expiresAt.
